if [ "${SANITIZER}" = address ]
then
    CONFIGURE_FLAGS="--enable-asan"
elif [ "${SANITIZER}" = undefined ]
then
    CONFIGURE_FLAGS="--enable-ubsan"
else
    CONFIGURE_FLAGS=""
fi
./utils/build/configure.py "${OUT}/build" --build-system "Ninja" ${CONFIGURE_FLAGS}                            --cmake-flags="-DHERMES_USE_STATIC_ICU=ON -DHERMES_FUZZING_FLAG=${LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE}"
cmake --build "$OUT/build"  --parallel --target fuzzer-jsi-entry
cp "${OUT}/build/bin/fuzzer-jsi-entry" "${OUT}"
